reglass.options.enable.name: Liquid Glass
reglass.options.enable.tooltip: Enable the ReGlass liquid glass interface.
reglass.options.glass_opacity.name: Glass Opacity
reglass.options.glass_opacity.tooltip: Controls how strong the transparent glass surface appears.
reglass.options.refraction.name: Refraction
reglass.options.refraction.tooltip: Controls the strength of the lens-like edge distortion.
reglass.options.highlight.name: Dynamic Highlight
reglass.options.highlight.tooltip: Controls the moving Fresnel-style highlight on glass edges.
reglass.options.morphing.name: Morphing
reglass.options.morphing.tooltip: Controls how quickly the active glass surface follows hovered and focused controls.
